title: LIGHT TO JANUS OCEAN — ANALYTICAL AND SYNTHETIC CAUSALITY CONTROLS

historical_light.timestamp_comment: Creation commit time and embedded text time differ; embedded timestamp is not independent evidence of observation time.
historical_light.original_format: Markdown-fenced JSON saved under a .json name
historical_light.original_hypothesis: Light is a noisy, multi-user API. Photosynthesis is a consensus protocol operating under interference.
historical_light.interpretation: Metaphor and conceptual sketch, not verified quantum optics, genomic code, or laboratory photosynthesis data.

linked_research.review_state_note: Not part of LIGHT-007; approval and hardware execution remain distinct.

tested_controls.check: E=hc/lambda for original LIGHT spectrum 450/660/730 nm. Blue photon energy higher than red and far red, with consistent wavelength ratio.
limitations: Not an experimental plant photoreceptor response
Wavelength is not literally an executable instruction

tested_controls.check: 2048 seeded idealized independent-arrival Poisson bins at rates 4 and 12; Fano-factor and relative mean sanity checks.
limitations: A toy arrival model, not universal light counting statistics
No photodiode or photon detector observations

tested_controls.check: Recover three-bin positive classical source-to-detector delay. Train on early bins, leave gap, locally freeze test predictions before scoring, reject future source access and compare held-out MAE with baseline.
limitations: No independent physical clock or attestation
A local precommit within one CI run is not an independently witnessed prospectively locked forecast
No physical speed of light measured

tested_controls.check: 4096 full synthetic A/C/B rows preserve unconditioned A/C independence; deliberate late-B selection makes a spurious extreme association. Original QPU005 Fisher via CTRL006 is used for the full-shot test.
limitations: Collider/postselection demonstration, not an experiment on delayed photons
Selected association is intentionally NOT used as primary evidence

tested_controls.check: Pin original fenced 2026 LIGHT file and current JSON, verify semantic equality, and rerun banana/006/QPU005 source-provenance gate.
limitations: Git hashes establish file identity, not independent physical event timestamps
